description: SaaS health advisor. POST your MRR/customers (+ optional churn/CAC/margin/growth) and get ARR/ARPA/LTV/CAC/payback/Rule-of-40/NRR/GRR computed, each with a health tag, plus an overall grade + a ranked "what to fix first" focus list. Deterministic math + advisory, no LLM.

cac.description: Acquisition cost per customer. Wins over sales_marketing_spend / new_customers.

churned_mrr.description: MRR lost to cancellations. Drives churn rate, LTV, NRR and GRR.

contraction_mrr.description: MRR lost to downgrades. Feeds NRR and GRR.

customers.description: Current paying accounts; divisor for ARPA.

expansion_mrr.description: MRR gained from upgrades. Feeds NRR.

gross_margin_pct.description: Gross margin in percent, e.g. 78. Wins over revenue/cogs.

growth_pct.description: MRR growth in percent, used only when prior_mrr is absent.

new_mrr.description: MRR from new customers. Accepted and validated, but no current metric uses it.

prior_mrr.description: MRR one period earlier. Enables growth, NRR and GRR; wins over growth_pct.

revenue.description: Period revenue; with cogs, derives gross margin.

sales_marketing_spend.description: Sales + marketing spend; with new_customers, derives CAC.

name: saas_metrics
